G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def transform(g):
    os_=objs(g)
    os_.sort(key=lambda o:(o['size'],o['c']))
    # 2x2 row-major placement
    top=[os_[0],os_[1]]; bot=[os_[2],os_[3]]
    lw=max(len(top[0]['sh'][0]),len(bot[0]['sh'][0]))
    th=max(len(top[0]['sh']),len(top[1]['sh']))
    thb=max(len(bot[0]['sh']),len(bot[1]['sh']))
    H=th+1+thb
    W=lw+1+max(len(top[1]['sh'][0]),len(bot[1]['sh'][0]))
    out=[[0]*len(g[0]) for _ in range(len(g))]
    r0=len(g)-H; c0=0
    for r,oi in ((r0,top),(r0+th+1,bot)):
        for cc,(col,o) in enumerate(zip((c0,c0+lw+1),oi)):
            for i,row in enumerate(o['sh']):
                for j,v in enumerate(row):
                    if v: out[r+i][col+j]=v
    return out

def transform(g):
    os_=objs(g)
    os_.sort(key=lambda o:o['size'])
    cleft=os_[0]['c']
    cols={}
    for o in os_: cols.setdefault(o['c'],[]).append(o)
    L=sorted(cols[cleft],key=lambda o:o['size'])
    R=[o for o in os_ if o['c']!=cleft]
    R=sorted(R,key=lambda o:o['size'])
    lw=max(max(len(o['sh'][0]) for o in L),0)
    th=max(len(o['sh']) for o in L+R)
    H=th+1+max(len(o['sh']) for o in L+R)
    W=lw+1+max(len(o['sh'][0]) for o in R)
    out=[[0]*len(g[0]) for _ in range(len(g))]
    r0=len(g)-H
    for r,oi in ((r0,L),(r0+th+1,R)):
        for col,o in zip((0,lw+1),oi):
            for i,row in enumerate(o['sh']):
                for j,v in enumerate(row):
                    if v: out[r+i][col+j]=v
    return out

                while q:

                ys=[p[0] for p in cells]; xs=[p[1] for p in cells]
                cs=set(cells)
                sh=[[c if (r,cc) in cs else 0 for cc in range(min(xs),max(xs)+1)] for r in range(min(ys),max(ys)+1)]

    return out

def transform(grid):

    cleft=sorted(os_,key=lambda o:(o['c0'],o['r0']))[0]['c']

    cols.sort(key=lambda col: 0 if col[0]['c']==cleft else 1)
    L,R=cols
